dct_description_sm: Attributed to Great Britain MI9 by comparison with another cloth map of the same title.
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.

Cloth map (silk). Relief shown by contours and spot heights. Shows boundaries, transportation networks, and other geographical features. Attributed to Great Britain MI9 by comparison with another cloth map of the same title. "Sheet C--Sheet D." Includes ancillary map of "Belgium & Germany (new frontier), scale 1:250,000." In upper right margins: 43/3--43/D. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Gift; Harry Martin Tinkham; 11-17-2004.
Contributors: American Folklife Center, collector; Great Britain. MI9; Veterans History Project (U.S.), collector
